Facts:
- The NHL Plus-Minus Award was an annual National Hockey League trophy for the ice hockey player who played at least 60 games and led the league in plus-minus statistics.
- Brad McCrimmon won the Plus-Minus Award in 1987–88 with a league-leading +48 while playing in Calgary.
- In 1987–88, Brad McCrimmon was also named a second team All-Star and played in the 1988 NHL All-Star Game.
- Pavel Datsyuk, born on 20 July 1978, is a Russian professional ice hockey player known as The Magic Man.
- Pavel Datsyuk served as captain of SKA Saint Petersburg in the Kontinental Hockey League.
- The NHL Plus-Minus Award was discontinued after it was awarded to Pavel Datsyuk following the season.
